title: Documentation and present-tense comments still name 'tk factory/cloud' commands ticfac serves
description:
cloudflare/README.md still says "`tk factory deploy` is the supported path" (~20 mentions), wrangler.toml and the D1 migration comments name `tk factory deploy` / `tk cloud status`, mint-factory-token.mjs's header says `tk factory deploy` will wrap it, and present-tense Go/TS comments (internal/factory/githubapp.go, credentials/credentials.go, status.go, dashboard/client.go + snapshot.go, deploy.go:532, gatewaytrace/trace.go:30, cloudflare/src/gateway.ts and runs.ts docblocks) name the old commands as the ones to run. These are maintainer- and doc-reader-facing, not binary output, so ogv left them; a sweep needs a historical-vs-current pass (D15/D16 decision records and incident narratives must stay as written), which is why it is a tick rather than a sed.

ticfac run epic-2jn filed this backlog tick from the finding 9def87ad9304ad63b4d7c0d75ff505228174b37d9cc6b0ff33d6ebba525be66c (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-ogv/attempt-31): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/9def87ad9304ad63b4d7c0d75ff505228174b37d9cc6b0ff33d6ebba525be66c.json on the run branch.
notes: 2026-09-27 15:55 - ticfac run epic-2jn: created by absorbing finding 9def87ad9304ad63b4d7c0d75ff505228174b37d9cc6b0ff33d6ebba525be66c — a backlog tick: the done is reachable with the finding standing. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/9def87ad9304ad63b4d7c0d75ff505228174b37d9cc6b0ff33d6ebba525be66c.json on epic/2jn, and it says: no classifier prediction could be made — no classifier is configured for gating predictions — so the reporter's own claim decides: it breaks no done item, and the finding is filed to the backlog rather than absorbed.
